["Q05","1) Once the Break token reaches the last space, ignore extra movement beyond that space. 2) The player who reaches it gains 1 X-token. 3) Finish the current turn; the break then occurs for everyone. 4) After the break, play continues clockwise with the next player.","supported","The Break track; Break procedure step 6."],
["Q06","1) Cards I: first advance the Break token 2 spaces, then either draw from the deck according to the strength table (maximum 3 draws, with any required discard) or, at strength 5+, snap exactly 1 display card of choice regardless of reputation and do not draw from the deck. 2) Cards II: also advance 2 spaces; draw from the deck and/or display cards within reputation range in any order using the upgraded table. ["Q07","1) Reputation range includes the display folder matching your Reputation counter and all lower-numbered folders. 2) Reputation 10 and above requires the upgraded Cards action. 3) At reputation 15, further reputation gains leave the counter at 15 and give 1 appeal per excess reputation step. 4) You may not look through the discard pile during the game.","supported","Reputation track and display."],
["Q08","1) Build I builds exactly 1 building of size no greater than action strength; Build II builds any number of different building types with total size no greater than strength, but never 2 identical buildings in one action. 2) Buildings cost 2 money per space, paid before placement. 3) The first building must have at least one space on a map border; later buildings must touch an existing building by at least one edge. 4) Build only on empty map spaces; no extending off-map, overlap, water or rock. ["Q09","1) Build I allows standard enclosures (sizes 1–5), kiosks, pavilions, and one Petting Zoo (size 3). 2) Build II additionally allows Reptile Houses and Large Bird Aviaries (size 5 each), as well as restricted-icon map spaces. 3) The supply contains 4 tiles of each special-enclosure type; each zoo may have at most 1 of each type. 4) Build cannot create unique buildings; those enter through Sponsor cards. 5) Covering all map spaces except water and rock immediately grants 7 appeal.","supported","Buildings available through Build; full zoo map."],

["Q11","1) To play an animal, meet all left-side conditions, pay its cost, then provide legal housing and terrain adjacency; place its card by the map and resolve appeal and other effects. 2) A partner zoo on the animal’s continent reduces cost by 3 money for each continent icon printed on that animal, so double matching icons reduce it by 6. 3) A standard enclosure must be empty, at least the animal’s printed minimum size, and is flipped as a whole to its occupied side; it normally houses one animal. 4) Petting Zoo animals must use a Petting Zoo; eligible reptiles and some birds may use a Reptile House or Large Bird Aviary if their indicated token-space requirement fits, placing one supply player token per space used. ["Q12","1) Animals II lets you play animals from display folders within your reputation range, with an extra cost equal to the folder number; hand and display animals may be mixed. 2) At strength 5+, you may optionally gain 1 reputation at the very start, before choosing animals, so the expanded range applies. 3) Do not replenish the display until the turn ends. 4) Animals II also permits animals whose conditions show the upgrade-required icon.","supported","Animals action, Side II."],
["Q13","1) Only immediately when building a Reptile House or Large Bird Aviary may you relocate all corresponding eligible animals that fit; choose separately for each animal. 2) Each moved animal must be suitable for that enclosure, meet its water/rock adjacency, and fit remaining capacity. ["Q14","1) Association task strengths are: increase reputation 2; gain partner zoo 3; gain university 4; conservation project work 5. 2) Association I performs exactly 1 task and needs at least 1 active worker; action strength must meet the task strength. 3) If you already have 1 of your workers on that task, place 2 workers to repeat it; if 3 of your workers are there, you cannot perform it again until after the break. 4) Opponents’ workers on a task do not matter. 5) Association II can perform one or more different tasks, spending 1 or 2 of your workers per task, provided total task value is no greater than action strength.","supported","Association action: side I and side II."],
["Q15","1) Take partner zoos and universities from available tiles on the Association board and place them on the lowest empty matching space on your zoo map; resolve a covered-space bonus immediately. 2) You cannot take a duplicate university; partner zoos must be from different continents, with a maximum of 4. 3) A third or fourth partner zoo requires Association II. ["Q16","1) Association project work may support a project already in play, or play a Conservation Project card from hand and support it immediately. ["Q18","1) Sponsors I plays exactly 1 Sponsor from hand, requiring action strength at least its level and all left-side conditions; alternatively advance the Break token by strength and take that much money. 2) Sponsors II plays one or more cards from hand and/or the in-range display; for each display card pay its folder number and do not replenish until turn end. ["Q19","1) Break order: discard to hand limit; return Multiplier, Venom and Constriction tokens; recall workers and restock available partner zoos/universities; discard display folders 1–2, compact and refill; take income; reset Break token. 2) Hand limit is normally 3 or 5 with the hand-limit university, checked only at breaks. 3) Each kiosk earns 1 money for every adjacent unique building, special enclosure, occupied standard enclosure, and pavilion; empty standard enclosures do not qualify, but empty special enclosures do. 4) When several players take display cards during break income, resolve them clockwise from the break initiator (or first affected player clockwise from them) and refill the display after each such player’s income, before the next affected player chooses.","supported","Break procedure, steps 1–6."],

["Q28","1) Animal categories are bird, herbivore, predator, primate, reptile, bear, and Petting Zoo animal. 2) Bear and Petting Zoo animal count as categories unless explicitly excluded; bears may also carry herbivore or predator icons.","supported","Animal categories; Base glossary."],
["Q29","1) A donation requires Association II and at least 1 Association task performed in that same action; it needs no worker, and you may donate at most once per Association action. 2) Pay the smallest amount still visible in the donation area and cover it with a player token from your supply, gaining 1 conservation. ["Q30","1) Zoo icons include upper-right icons on Animal and Sponsor cards, plus water/rock requirements in upper-left corners of Animal cards and unique-building Sponsor cards; partner-zoo continent icons and university research icons also count. 2) Do not count left-side play conditions or Conservation Project icons; university reputation and hand-limit benefits are not icons. 3) An effect can count its own card; doubled icons count twice, while distinct-icon-type requests count each type once. 4) Card text takes priority over general rules.","supported","Counting icons in your zoo; shared principles."],

["Q32","1) Bringing a new Release into the Wild project into play grants 1 reputation; later support of an existing release project grants no reputation for that play bonus. 2) Breeding Program projects have the same condition for all three reward spaces; choose any available space under normal support rules.","supported","Release into the wild; Other illustrated project rewards."],
["Q33","1) In an “X : Y” effect, X on the left is the condition and Y on the right is the reward. 2) A condition without a number, or with “per,” pays once per fulfillment. 3) A numbered threshold pays only once; if multiple thresholds are met, use the highest one met.","supported","Base glossary: shared principles."],

["Q37","1) Assertion searches the unused face-down base-project deck and adds a chosen project to hand; Dominance gets its named project from that same deck. 2) Dominance does nothing if its named project is already in play. 3) Later, play and immediately support the obtained card through Association, placing it above the Association board, not in the setup base-project row below.","supported","Base animal ability clarifications: Assertion / Dominance."],
["Q38","1) Boost and Clever resolve after finishing Animals and moving that Action card. 2) Clever puts the chosen card in slot 1; Boost puts the named card in slot 1 or 5. 3) Moving to slot 1 shifts cards formerly to its left right. ["Q39","1) All affected zoos must have at least 5 appeal; the playing animal’s appeal may be awarded before or after its ability, so normally need not count for target eligibility. 2) Constriction affects every other zoo with at least 5 appeal ahead of yours on appeal and/or conservation. ["Q41","1) At effective strength zero or below, you may not use the constricted regular action as-is: spend enough X-tokens to reach at least strength 1, take the alternative X-token action, or leave the card until it is at least in slot 3. 2) The X-token action is allowed only if you hold fewer than 5 X-tokens.","supported","Constriction clarification; X-token action."],

["Q43","1) A flock animal may avoid a new enclosure if another herbivore in your zoo has a printed standard-enclosure requirement at least as large as the flock animal’s; that same host herbivore can host any number of flock animals. 2) Without a qualifying herbivore, house it normally; a later non-flock herbivore cannot join it in that enclosure. 3) On release, no proof of the original housing is required: follow the release procedure to free an occupied enclosure even if the flock animal shared it; historical residents are not tracked.","supported","Flock Animal clarification."],

["Q78","1) Diversity Researcher gives 2 money per water/rock icon immediately. 2) It lets you cover water/rock spaces and ignore terrain requirements for animals and unique buildings. 3) Covered terrain no longer counts for Hydrologist, Geologist or Architectural Zoo; terrain need not be covered for full-map scoring. 4) Final scoring gives 2 appeal per water-icon/rock-icon pair, maximum 3 pairs.","supported","Base Sponsor reference: 219 Diversity Researcher."],
